dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
Braves' Bats Explode in 10-5 Thrashing of Pirates

The Atlanta Braves offense put on a show in a 10-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin leading the charge. Olson had a strong game, while Baldwin's clutch hitting helped the Braves take control. On the mound, the staff effort was enough to secure the victory. In another game, the New York Mets' Sean Manaea pitched a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 6 and allowing just 2 earned runs in a 3-7 win over the Kansas City Royals.

Yankees' Bullpen Dominates in 12-4 Rout of Rays

The New York Yankees' bullpen shined in a 12-4 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Angel Chivilli striking out 3 in 2.0 innings of work. Ben Rice hit 2 home runs and drove in 5 runs to lead the Yankees' offense. Cody Bellinger also had a key single in the win.

Guardians' Gavin Williams Shuts Down Twins in 5-2 Win

Cleveland Guardians' pitcher Gavin Williams pitched 7.0 innings of shutout ball, striking out 11 and allowing just 2 earned runs in a 5-2 win over the Minnesota Twins. Royce Lewis hit a home run for the Twins, but it wasn't enough to overcome Williams' dominant performance.
